subject: Confirmation requested on the Section 31 23 00 minimum cover requirement for the

messages.text: At Pour Sequence 4, the geotechnical report doesn't clearly speak to the Section 31 23 00 minimum cover requirement for the underground utility trench backfill -- can the civil inspector sign off on it as shown? This is becoming more pressing as backfill work approaches. A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.
The geotechnical report already covers this -- see Detail 6/C-601 for the Section 31 23 00 minimum cover requirement for the underground utility trench backfill. No further action needed.
